+    def test_main_quoted_comma_field_stays_single_field(self, tmp_path, capsys):
+        """Regression: a quoted field containing a comma must stay one field."""
+        path = write_csv(tmp_path, 'name,notes\n"Doe, Jane",likes pie\n')
+        exit_code = fmtcsv.main([str(path)])
+        out = capsys.readouterr().out
+        assert exit_code == 0
+        assert out == (
+            "Total rows: 1\n"
+            "Total columns: 2\n"
+            "First data row: ['Doe, Jane', 'likes pie']\n"
+        )
+
     def test_missing_file_exits_nonzero(self, tmp_path, capsys):
         with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as excinfo:
             fmtcsv.main([str(tmp_path / "nope.csv")])
         assert excinfo.value.code == 2
